marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Candle, part of the LED Filament Candle Series, offers a warm white light with a color temperature of 2700K and 400 lumens output. This 5W LED bulb has a candelabra base with an E12 base code and is Energy Star Certified and Title 20 Compliant. It has a lifespan of 15000 hours and is equivalent to a 40W incandescent bulb.
